guitar.evidence: Carlos Santana's long-running signature relationship with PRS (Paul Reed Smith) guitars is extremely well documented; earlier career also used Gibson SG/Yamaha SG.
guitar.notes: Original entry correct; simplified to lead with the most iconic/current association (PRS Santana).

tone.target: singing Santana sustain with creamy lead drive
tone.profile: singing Santana sustain with creamy lead drive
tone.summary: A smooth signal chain utilizing light compression, a mid-focused overdrive, and an AC30-style amp paired with a vintage 4x12 to achieve Santana's signature sustained, vocal lead sound.
corrections: use creamy sustain, not clean breakup

rig.name: Santana - Samba Pa Ti - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.

Add subtle ambience and 'bloom' without sounding overly wet.
